short_description: AI on your phone. Free. Works in airplane mode.
full_description:
AGI runs on your device first. No cloud required, no account needed, no data leaving your phone for Local Mode.

Most AI apps funnel your conversations through remote servers. AGI is different: responses can be generated by an open-source language model running on your device. Airplane mode? Still works. No Wi-Fi? Still works.

WORKS OFFLINE
The default model downloads once over Wi-Fi and runs locally after that. No Local Mode inference calls hit AGI Cloud. Your local conversations stay on this device and are encrypted at rest.

FREE AT INFERENCE, FOREVER
Local on-device inference is free and always will be. There is no usage limit, no per-message charge, no subscription required to use the core chat.

CLOUD WHEN YOU CHOOSE IT
AGI Cloud is in public alpha: sign in for cloud chat and web search on the free tier, with image generation on Pro and above. There are no in-app purchases in this version.

PRIVACY FIRST
We do not claim full DPDP Act 2023 compliance. Our itemised India DPDP notice is published at https://agiworkforce.com/privacy/india, and the obligations we have not met, verifiable parental consent, notice in Eighth Schedule languages, and India data residency among them, are listed at https://agiworkforce.com/trust. AI output is labelled as AI-generated, and first run names the on-device model and any cloud provider. Local Mode collects no personal data by default. Signing in to AGI Cloud uses your account email (and name, if provided by your sign-in method) to create your account. Export or delete your local data at any time from Settings.

INDIA-FIRST
AGI is designed to work well on the connections and devices common across India: it runs offline, installs once, and handles Hindi queries.

Built by AGI Automation LLC, USA.

target_audience.note: 18+ is what the binary enforces. getAgeThreshold in apps/mobile/src/features/auth/services/ageGate.ts takes the larger of the device time zone's regional age (18 for India and Brazil, 16 for EU member-state zones and North Macedonia, 13 for the United Kingdom and every other zone) and ACCOUNT_HOLDER_MINIMUM_AGE (18, packages/contracts/types/src/account-eligibility.ts), so every region asks for 18 before Cloud sign-in and 18 and over is the only declared band. An age under 18 is refused with the account age notice and puts the install into one-way minor-safe mode, which filters every outgoing prompt against a shared blocklist before it reaches any model and cannot be switched off from inside the app.

data_collected_types.collected_when: Only when the user signs in to use AGI Cloud (public alpha, open to any signed-in user).
Only if provided by the user's sign-in method when signing in to AGI Cloud.
Only in AGI Cloud: the messages the user sends are uploaded to AGI Cloud and forwarded to the model provider serving the request. Local Mode uploads nothing.
Only in AGI Cloud: photos attached to a message or set as the account avatar are uploaded.
Only in AGI Cloud: documents attached to a message are uploaded.

Only during live voice mode in an AGI Cloud chat: the microphone is streamed to AGI Cloud for the session and the transcript is saved to that chat. Dictation transcribes on the device and uploads no audio.
Only after sign-in: the account identifier carried by every authenticated cloud request.
Only after the user enables push notifications: an app-generated device UUID is registered with the push token. No advertising identifier is collected.

Only in AGI Cloud and only after the user allows product analytics in Settings, Privacy (off by default; a workspace administrator can also turn it off): event names such as a stopped or regenerated response, recorded against the account. No message, file or file name is included. Local Mode sends none.

data_safety.note: Local Mode collects no personal data by default and uploads nothing. Signing in to AGI Cloud collects account email, optional name, account and device identifiers, and the conversation content and attachments the user sends. Every type is optional because Cloud sign-in is optional: a signed-out user who has completed onboarding lands in Local Mode and is never redirected to a sign-in wall (apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx). The ground fact behind the sharing answer, stated plainly: in Cloud mode the user's messages and attachments leave the device, reach AGI Cloud, and are forwarded server-side to the model provider serving the request. 'Data shared' is answered false on the service-provider basis, the model, storage, auth and push subprocessors listed at https://agiworkforce.com/subprocessors process that data on AGI's behalf, not for their own purposes. What the source tree proves: every outbound request from the device goes to an AGI-controlled host (apps/mobile/lib/constants.ts) plus Clerk for sign-in and the push service, so no third party receives data directly from the device; and apps/mobile/package.json declares no analytics, crash-reporting or ad SDK (no Sentry, Firebase, Crashlytics, Amplitude, PostHog, Mixpanel, Segment, Bugsnag or Datadog), so no telemetry stream leaves for a third party's own purposes. Whether Play's service-provider exception covers each subprocessor is a contractual question the repo cannot settle; it rests on the data-processing terms behind that subprocessor list. store-listing/android/data-safety.json declares the same types with the same sharing and optionality answers, the two files no longer disagree, and REVIEWER-NOTES-ANDROID.md records the same reconciliation for the Play reviewer.

in_app_products.note: The Android binary includes Google Play Billing. New purchases require an enabled server catalog, registered Play product IDs, and account upgrade access; checked-in backend templates leave MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED off. Billing still shows Restore purchases while new sales are off, and configured products remain eligible for receipt verification. Before offering purchases in a submitted build, register the products, change has_in_app_products to true, replace the description's no-purchases claim, provide Play Review a signed-in account and access code, and test purchase, restore, renewal, and refund with Play test purchases. This repository cannot prove current live deployment or Play Console state. The binary links expo-iap; the server owner is mobile-iap-catalog.ts. When the deployment flag is off, the catalog reason is "Native purchases are not enabled for this deployment." On iOS without registered products it is "App Store products have not been registered for this build." On Android without registered products it is "Google Play products have not been registered for this build." The Billing screen can show "Loading native purchases" and "Workspace administration" before or alongside its store status.

release_notes_v0_0_1:
AGI 0.0.1, Cloud public alpha.

• Free AGI Cloud chat is open to signed-in users without an invite
• Paid upgrades require an access code; users can join the waitlist
• Cloud chat and web search on the free tier; image generation on Pro and above
• On-device AI chat still works fully offline, no account needed
• Catalog-selected on-device model downloads once and runs locally
• On-device voice transcription
• India DPDP notice published, with our open gaps listed at agiworkforce.com/trust

Email support@agiworkforce.com, we read everything.
